name: Tanzania Development Vision 2050
detail: The overarching development goals. Launched 17 July 2025.

name: Long Term Perspective Plan (LTPP) 2026/27-2050/51
detail: Phases the Vision across five successive development plans.

name: Five-Year Development Plans (FYDP IV-VIII)
detail: FYDP IV is the first implementation phase; each plan carries the Vision forward five years.
